## What's new in 1.5.4

- **New: iPhone / iPad app** (iOS 15+): `GundilIntercom-1.5.4-ios-unsigned.ipa`.
  - Two-way calls and encryption like on the other devices. A call keeps going with the screen off or another app open. You can watch the other side's camera video; sending video from the iPhone isn't supported yet.
  - Install it with **AltStore** or **Sideloadly** and your own Apple ID (Apple only lets signed apps onto an iPhone). With a free Apple ID the app has to be refreshed every 7 days; AltStore does this by itself.
  - iPhones can't find intercoms automatically (iOS blocks the LAN broadcast without a special Apple permission): add them with **Add peer by IP**. Once the iPhone connected, the other intercom knows it too.
  - The iPhone answers calls while the app is open or in a call; iOS pauses apps in the background, so there is no always-on mode like on Android.
- **New: Mac app** (macOS 10.15+, Apple silicon and Intel): `GundilIntercom-1.5.4-macos.zip`.
  - Same as the Windows and Linux desktop app: finds intercoms on the LAN by itself, two-way calls, receiving video. Sending video from the Mac camera and the menu-bar (tray) icon aren't supported yet.
  - Not notarized by Apple: the first time, right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
- **Android:** settings are no longer copied by Android's automatic backup. After a reinstall the app starts fresh, and moving to a new phone no longer gives two phones the same intercom identity (which made them invisible to each other).

Upgrading: Android installs over 1.5.3 and keeps settings (if you still have 1.5.2 or older, uninstall once first). Works with 1.2.0 – 1.5.3. Versions before 1.2.0 (including 1.1.1) can't connect, because they don't encrypt.
